Le nom d’ouverture sélectionne les codes: Opening names select ECO codes from the Lichess catalog, not an exact variation. Use the board position for that. Elo filters exclude unknown ratings. Material is searched in all variations.

Placez l’échiquier sur la position à pré: Set the board to the position you want to prepare. Continuations are calculated from games matching the filters.
Une borne Elo active exclut les parties: An active Elo bound excludes games with either rating missing; an active date range excludes unknown years. No Elo is estimated.
No continuation prepared for this position.
Une partie compte une fois par coup, que: A game counts once per move, regardless of move order or repetitions. These frequencies describe the selected database; they establish neither a move’s quality nor its theoretical novelty.
Préparez une étude avec ses variantes, p: Prepare a study with variations, then create your repertoire.
Réponses adverses présentes dans la bibl: Opponent replies present in the library but missing from the repertoire, sorted by frequency (up to 100). Absence does not establish a theoretical novelty.
Aucune réponse manquante trouvée dans la: No missing replies found in the local database.
Positions où au moins un rappel a échoué: Positions with at least one failed recall. This tracks memorization of your prepared moves, not their chess quality.
Toutes les variantes accessibles de l’ét: All reachable study variations are added. Transpositions share replies and reviews.
Les coups préparés et leurs révisions se: Prepared moves and reviews will be deleted. Library games will be kept.
Les suites devenues inaccessibles seront: Unreachable continuations will be removed. Reachable transpositions keep their reviews.

Ajouter une copie de l’étude ouverte à l: Add a copy of the open study to the queue
Les résultats sont sauvegardés à chaque: Results are saved at every position. After an interruption, choose Resume. WDL is the engine’s estimate from White’s perspective, not a prediction of your result.
Interrompu ou actif dans une autre insta: Interrupted or active in another instance
Sélectionnez une analyse pour voir ses r: Select an analysis to view its results.
Results will be removed from the queue. The original game is kept.
Sélectionnez 2 à 4 profils enregistrés d: Select 2 to 4 profiles saved in settings. Each engine analyzes the same position using its MultiPV and Syzygy tables.

La comparaison suit la navigation de l’é: Comparison follows board navigation. Resources are limited to 1 GiB total hash, sharing the available processors.
Démarrez le moteur pour lire ses options: Start the engine to read its options.
Appliquez les changements avec « Démarre: Apply changes with “Start / apply”, then save the profile. Strength limits apply only to playing games.
Les parties sont conservées par lots de: Games are saved in batches of 250. After a pause or crash, resumption starts at the last committed batch. The entire file is verified with SHA-256 before every resumption.
Retirer un import de cette liste conserv: Removing an import from this list keeps all its games in the library. The standard import remains available for full cancellation.
Aucun import PGN enregistré depuis cette: No PGN imports recorded since this version.

Evaluations from White’s perspective. Click the graph or a move to revisit the position.
Seuils indicatifs : 50 / 100 / 250 centi: Indicative thresholds: 50 / 100 / 250 centipawns. Results depend on the engine and thinking time; exercises follow its main variation.

Motifs observés, sans garantie de gain f: Observed patterns do not guarantee a forced win. In the copy: green arrows show attacks, yellow marks show pin/skewer alignments. The engine line may change; repetitions before the diagram are not reproduced.
Demi-coups sans prise ni pion: Half-moves without capture or pawn move
. Pion = 1, cavalier/fou = 3, tour = 5,: . Pawn = 1, knight/bishop = 3, rook = 5, queen = 9. This count does not measure position quality.
